notes.title: Patch notes: 1.1.1
notes.content:
Thank you for playing ENDER MAGNOLIA.

We just released the version 1.1.1, which contains bug fixes.
Thank you for your support!

Patch notes: 1.1.1
Adjustments:

Update some illustrations in the "Extra" menu

Bug fixes:

Fix some tutorial videos
Fix an animation problem on the player character when using a skill while running due to hitstop logic
Fix some enemies in the "Land of Origin" area that would completely stop attacking after losing sight of the player character
Fix a bug where bosses could be stuck in a frozen state on death
Fix auto skills that were not correctly auto-summoned after using "Fast Travel" from a rest point.
Fix some translation errors
Various minor fixes

notes.title: Patch notes: 1.1.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899173/f2aa6521e047c8ac75c8bac36be0037acb7493b6.png
Patch notes: 1.1.0

New features:

◆Test your skills by challenging the new "Boss rush" mode

Unlocked by defeating all the bosses in the game.
Accessed by the "Memories" menu, "Boss rush" tab from any rest point.
Clear times and best attempts are saved as records.
Receive "Fragments" by clearing the challenge. The number of fragment received depends on the selected difficulty.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899173/a1904cf90c0beb774769d07082746d72ae61656c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899173/e2118d4253ea8b303d4f3dfd46f0274b94aed74a.png


◆Boss rematch feature

Accessed by the "Memories" menu, "Bosses" tab from any rest point.
Receive "Fragments" by clearing the challenge. The number of fragment received depends on the selected difficulty.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899173/079096ab95ed90112b98bbed73d5cdeb4b1a894a.png


◆Carry over your progress and explore a harsher world with "New Game +"

Unlocked by clearing the game and seeing a specific ending.
Start the game from the beginning while keeping your parameters, skills and items.
All enemies will be of higher difficulty, starting the game on a chapter higher than the previous maximum, and bosses will have more aggressive patterns.
※Items related to quests will not carry over.

Items that were obtained previously will be replaced by either "Material" or "Junk" in New Game +.
Items that were not previously obtained can still be obtained in New Game +.
Items that were replaced in New Game + will be placed again when carrying data over a second time.

New "Relic" upgrade level (++)
"Relics" that were upgraded to the "+" level can be upgraded again to the "++" level at the relic refinery.
※Upgrading a relic to "++" will further increase its effect or lower its slot cost.
※"Relics" that could not be upgraded before are still not upgradable.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899173/9f43ee9aa480fa7e400efb288cbc91146db821bd.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899173/f5cc9bebaee74e935913b622947cd0704d6e673b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899173/cb8dfadfaa0bce492c95c581aac6701459b5f8e7.png

◆Other additions

Add a set logic to Skill, Equipment and Relics to easily switch between equipments
Add new gallery items and costumes obtainable by spending "Fragments".

Adjustments:

Adjust some events to make scenario specific triggers a bit easier to understand
Bug fixes:

Translation fixes
Small visual and gameplay fixes

notes.title: Patch notes: 1.0.4
notes.content:
Thank you for playing ENDER MAGNOLIA.

We just released the version 1.0.4, which contains a few gameplay adjustments and bug fixes.
Thank you for your support!

Patch notes: 1.0.4
Adjustments:

Enemies parameter adjustments

Support robot summoned by "Luiseach, the Iron Witch": lower stamina and
resistance to status effects

Add automatic recognition of Joy-Con controller through Steam
Adjust visuals between the "Central Stratum - Steel District" and "Declan's Estate" areas
to make the area change easier to see
Adjust some SE that were too loud
Adjust some routes in the "Sorcerer's Academy" area to make it easier to reach students
Elemental damage (status effect value) is now nullified if the corresponding status effect is already set
Automatically re-summon "Muninn" and "Huginn" after an event
Hide the "Compare" window when selecting a Carapace in the Craftory
Brush up of animations on some enemies
Brush up some UI elements
Brush up some background visuals


Bug fixes:

Fix input bug that would not allow to summon two pressure skills when buttons were pressed at the same frame
When using the "Instant death" challenge, blighted damage area will not instantly kill anymore due to being necessary for game progression
Fix the map completion display in "Crystalline Realm" when skipping a specific encounter
Fix the effect of the "Headless Gold Statue+" relic
Fix some translations errors
Various minor visual and gameplay related fixes

notes.title: Patch notes: 1.0.3
notes.content:
Thank you for playing ENDER MAGNOLIA.

We just released the version 1.0.3,
a small update containing mostly bug fixes and balance adjustments.
Thank you for sharing your feedbacks and issues with us.

Patch notes: 1.0.3
Adjustments:

Enemies parameter adjustments

Reinforced Lab Rat: lower attack, stamina and resistance to status effects
Experimental Manufacturer (Rat generator): lower HP
Combat Puppet: No. 20, 14, 56 ("Arena Tower" mini bosses): lower HP to increase tempo of the battle sequence
Combat Puppet: No. 7 ("Arena Tower" boss): lower the power of some attacks
Other small adjustments on various enemies

Add platforms in the "Crimson Forest" area  to allow for better shortcuts
Add visual representation of the general teleportation direction on warp points for easier navigation
Lower the effectiveness of some skills of "Lorna"
Brush up of some background visuals


Bug fixes:

Fix the map completion that was not rendered properly on some GPU*
In the area "Land of origin", concerning a specific growth:

Fix the visibility state that would sometimes stay invisible
change the geometry of the level to make the growth easier to break, especially on low FPS machines

Fix the BGM of the boss in the "Magicite Mine" area
Parry actions:

Fix player collision size after parry actions that could stay bigger than normal for a few frames
Fix parry actions that were not resetting airborne action count correctly

Translations and texts fixes
Various small behaviour, visual and animation fixes


We will continue to make fixes and improvements to make ENDER MAGNOLIA an enjoyable experience.
Thank you for your support!


* While we believe the bug is fixed, we couldn't test many GPU yet.
If the bug is still present in the latest version, please try to launch the game
using either "-dx11" or "-vulkan" as a launch option through Steam
while we work on fixing it.

notes.title: Plans for next version (1.0.3)
notes.content:
Thank you for playing ENDER MAGNOLIA: Bloom in the Mist

We are grateful for your feedbacks on the full release of the game,
and would like to make a small announcement regarding the next small update we are planning.

Besides bug fixes and small adjustments, we want to highlight the next changes that will be in 1.0.3:

The enemy "Reinforced Lab Rat" will have its parameters lowered, which should make their swarm easier to manage
"Crimson Forest" will have new platforms to allow for better shortcuts


The date of release will be announced shortly.

We will continue to make fixes and improvements to make ENDER MAGNOLIA an enjoyable experience.
Thank you for your support!

notes.title: ENDER MAGNOLIA Releases today!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899173/454dd68bc22ee85ea4bd50b5a17980b6000624f8.png

Thank you for your interest in ENDER MAGNOLIA.

Thanks to everyone's support, we were able to release the full version of ENDER MAGNOLIA: Bloom in the Mist.
We received a lot of feedbacks and opinions from players during the early access, and would like to thank everyone for sharing your views on the game.

As an early access game, if you bought the game already,
the conversion to full version will be done automatically at no charge.

▼ Notes
As we have previously announced, the areas accessible during early access
were slightly modified due to adjustments and tutorial changes.
As a result, save data from the early access can not be used in the full version.


▼ New additions
Below are some of the additions and modifications made since Early Access.
Because there is a huge number of them, we will only list the most representative ones.

added new areas, bosses, and enemies
added new skills
added new items
added new game systems
added tutorials
added difficulty settings
added UI and quality of life improvements
added musics


▼ Changes from Early Access
Based on players' feedbacks, we have made slight adjustments and additions
to the areas available in Early Access.

level design and game balance adjustments
animation improvements
tutorial addition
enemy placements and AI adjustments
skill adjustments
text and translations improvements
background improvements


▼ Update schedule
We are planning to add the following features in a future update.

fight against a boss previously defeated (Boss Rematch)
challenge all bosses in succession (Boss Rush)
after clearing the game, replaying the game while conserving the player state (New Game+)


▼ Original Soundtrack
To accompany the release of the full version, the soundtrack is now also available on steam.
Following on from ENDER LILIES, all of the music has been composed by the group "Mili".
We hope you will enjoy the world of ENDER MAGNOLIA brought to life
by its fairytale-like music.

notes.title: 0.5.1 Patch note
notes.content:
Thank you for playing ENDER MAGNOLIA and helping us into making it a better game.
The team is currently working hard on the development of the game to make sure it meets your expectations.

We are updating the game to 0.5.1 with a focus on bug fixes,
and we would like to use this opportunity to address the main topics of discussion we see coming often:

Regarding the areas that are currently playable in the early version of the game
At the time of the full release, we plan to expand on those area a bit by adding more discoverable items and changing the terrain.
We will continue to brush up those areas to make exploration more engaging.

Regarding the game's difficulty
We are aiming for a more linear difficulty, with the difficulty ramping up progressively through the game.
The future areas should offer more challenging battles.
If you are worried about the difficulty, we plan to have different difficulty settings that can be changed at any time to your liking.

Regarding cutscenes
We are aware of the subtitles displaying too fast in most language, and are planing to correct this.

Thank you for your patience, and please look forward to future development.


Updates in version 0.5.1.
Bug fixes :

Some translation fixes
Fixed some enemy parameters and behavior bugs
- Fixed a bug in the player's behavior when triggering the skill of "Aerial Scout Muninn"
- Fixed a bug in the player's behavior when triggering the skill of "Lito, the Child Test Subject"
Fixed a rare crash when changing application focus
Set VSYNC to be enabled by default to avoid unnecessary resource usage
Fixed the "Fast Travel" button the map menu that didn't reflect correctly the binding of "confirm" button
Fixed a freeze that could happen when changing area and pausing the game at the same time
Map display fixes
- When a zone is complete and turns blue, it will now display the map change interaction points
Fixed "Fast Travel", "Back To Respite" that could be used during a map change interaction
Fixed the controller type recognition after disconnecting / reconnecting a controller
Fixed other minor UI-related bugs.
